sources.title: Mulligan: Performance-Guided Data Collection for Efficient On-Robot ...
sources.snippet: Across three real-world tasks evaluated on 2,550 held-out, blinded episodes and two simulated tasks, Mulligan outperforms uniform sampling of initial states at matched supervised collection budgets, and combined with value-based action selection, HiL-IDQL+Mulligan, improves final real-task success by 14-34 percentage points over the baseline.
